the combination of CpG oligodeoxyribonucleotide 7909 (CpG ODN790) and X-ray irradiations enhances the mitotic death rate of A549 human lung adenocarinoma cells, and that this effect can be partly inhibited by the knockdown of the CHK2 gene.

the radiosensitization of CpG ODNA7909 in lung carcinoma A549 cells was attenuated by silencing of CHK2 expression, suggesting that the CHK2 pathway might be a potential target for the treatment of lung cancer.

the radiosensitivity enhancement of CpG ODNA7909 in human lung cancer cells, which may help in the development of a new radiosensitizer for the treatment of lung cancer.
the impact of a CpG ODN on radiosensitivity in human lung adenoca-rinoma A549 cell, and the results provide a new insight into the radiosensitization effect of CpG ODS on lung cancer cells.
